staticObservations.statement: Constructing Client immediately creates a module Worker from its bundled asset URL; this is already outside this passive intake.
create constructs Client, gets signer identifier, initializes it, then registers unless disableAutoRegister; build also constructs/initializes with registration disabled.
register requests inbox association signature text, invokes signer.signMessage, and sends registerIdentity to the Worker; this is identity association, not spending approval.
Every Worker message awaits WASM init before its try block; client.init then calls WorkerClient.create and exposes installation/inbox IDs.
createBackend awaits WASM init, defaults env to dev, and allows apiUrl/gatewayHost overrides before building Backend; none of these calls was made.

createClient obtains or generates inbox ID, defaults a database filename, passes optional dbEncryptionKey, enables DeviceSync unless disabled, and invokes WASM createClientWithBackend; allowOffline is undefined.

Source declares localhost/dev/production API constants (deprecated) and environment-specific history service URLs. These declarations are not a selected product profile or complete WASM egress inventory.
publishMessages and send post Worker actions; a returned SDK message ID does not satisfy the application envelope/authentication/delivery contracts.
streamAllMessages performs conversation sync unless disableSync and then starts a Worker stream; consentStates is an optional argument, not repository user consent.
Archive defaults include consent/messages and excludeDisappearingMessages false; sync request/archive methods choose environment history URL. No retention/deletion guarantee follows.
Opfs also immediately creates a module Worker; create invokes its init action.
OPFS Worker awaits WASM init for each message and opfs.init invokes opfsInit; delete/import/export/clear methods exist in the same retained file but were not invoked.
WorkerBridge stores pending action promises and posts messages; this wrapper shows no per-action timeout, AbortSignal or fixed pending-map cap.

Stream disposal sends endStream and removes a listener; close removes two listeners then calls standard Worker.terminate(), with no native closure completion promise or explicit rejection/clearing of pending actions in this method.
Worker error handler logs event.message; logging-enabled message handling also logs event data. Repository error-redaction policy is not established by this wrapper.
Worker catch forwards the caught error object via postMessageError, rather than a repository allowlisted error code.
Generated WASM host-import functions invoke both receiver.fetch and global fetch. A main-window-only wrapper cannot establish all Worker/WASM routing.
Generated host imports expose createSyncAccessHandle; getDirectory/getDirectoryHandle imports also exist in this file. Availability is not a tested browser/storage contract.
WASM init defaults to adjacent bindings_wasm_bg.wasm, fetches the URL then loads/instantiates; finalization invokes __wbindgen_start. None was executed.

The T50 candidate adds static fetchLatestInboxUpdatesCount: it constructs an ephemeral identifier and low-level client (dbPath null, device sync disabled), fetches network inbox updates and frees the WASM client. Even this helper is not a passive probe.
The candidate inserts workerConfig into the WASM createClientWithBackend call; published 7.0.0 source has a different positional call with stable WASM 1.10.0. No override/alias joins them.
